The remote and the branch are already set. The push cannot run yet because this folder has no commits.

- `origin` is `git@github.com:shippinAI/shipping-tech.git`
- the current branch is `main`
- GitHub repo [shippinAI/shipping-tech](https://github.com/shippinAI/shipping-tech) exists, is empty, and is **public**

Everything here is still untracked (source, `Cargo.toml`, Dockerfiles, and the rest). `git push -u origin main` needs at least one commit on `main` before it can upload anything.

Say if you want an initial commit of the current files, and I will commit and then run `git push -u origin main`. Because the GitHub repo is public, that commit will be visible to anyone.
